summary: Normalize cached workspace links so same-key dependency generations can be reused across clone roots without reading another clone's mutable sources.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only dependency caches. Five-file keys remain unchanged. Staging normalizes source workspace links; incompatible published generations fail closed and remain immutable.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners use a fresh cache root when adopting normalized-link invariants.

recovery.detail: Production rollback state remains unchanged; escaped dependency links refuse preparation rather than reading another clone.
